description: This file defines templates and functions for interfacing with rocBLAS, a GPU-accelerated BLAS library, specifically for GEMM operations with various data types, including support for different solution strategies and data type conversions.

classes.name: RocblasGemmOp
classes.description: Template class for performing GEMM operations using rocBLAS with a specific solution index.

classes.name: RocblasGemmStridedBatchedOp
classes.description: Template class for performing strided batched GEMM operations using rocBLAS with a specific solution index.

methods.name: RocBlasDataTypeFor
methods.description: Template function returning rocblas_datatype for a given C++ type.

methods.name: RocBlasComputeTypeFor
methods.description: Template function returning rocblas_datatype for compute type for a given C++ type.

methods.name: DoCastForHalfOrBfloat16
methods.description: Function to cast Half or BFloat16 types to float for computation.

methods.name: GetRocBlasGemmTypeStringAndOps
methods.description: Retrieves available GEMM solution strategies for a specific data type.

methods.name: GetRocBlasGemmStridedBatchedTypeStringAndOps
methods.description: Retrieves available strided batched GEMM solution strategies for a specific data type.
